name: access-control
description: Access governance, application portal, declarative configuration, and provisioning control plane.

scripts.smoke: pnpm run db:migrate:local && vitest run test/integration/worker-runtime.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run config -- validate --file config/example.json && pnpm run types && tsc --noEmit && pnpm run lint && prettier --check . && pnpm run test
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc --remote
